# Upstream suites

A library's own phpunit suite is the largest body of PHP written to pin PHP's
behaviour that this repository can run. `run.sh` clones a library, installs it
with phpunit, and runs its tests under php and under phpx, so a difference in
the totals is a difference in the language.

```sh
phpx/testdata/upstream/run.sh pimple https://github.com/silexphp/Pimple.git src/Pimple/Tests
PHPX=/tmp/phpx phpx/testdata/upstream/batch.sh /tmp/upstream.log        # every library of libraries.txt
PHPX=/tmp/phpx phpx/testdata/upstream/batch.sh /tmp/upstream.log yaml   # one of them
```

The checkouts live in `.cache/`, which git ignores. A run passes
`--no-configuration` because phpunit reads its XML configuration through
`DOMDocument`, which phpx does not carry, and `--bootstrap vendor/autoload.php`
in place of what the configuration named.

The `launcher.php` is the one of the framework shims: it skips the entry
script's extension gate. A library whose suite needs a package of its own
(prophecy, mockery) lists it after the test path in `libraries.txt`.

## What the totals say

The table is regenerated by the batch; a row reads as the last run left it.

| Library | php | phpx |
|---------|-----|------|
| pimple | 68 tests, 135 assertions | the same |
| doctrine/inflector | 1215 tests, 1238 assertions | the same |
